headline: PHP flaw dubbed PHP2Shell forces emergency patches and site shutdowns worldwide
summary: Two critical PHP vulnerabilities, PHP2Shell, prompted emergency patches after reports that hackers began exploiting them roughly four days before the fix shipped. Governments and companies took sites offline as a precaution, and outlets differ on whether OpenAI's AI specifically, or AI generally, helped uncover the flaws.

claims.statement: Two critical remote-code-execution vulnerabilities, tracked together as PHP2Shell, were disclosed with emergency patches.

sources.quote: two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) tracked collectively as PHP2Shell
The PHP Foundation has revealed two serious vulnerabilities that could impact millions of websites.

claims.statement: PHP underpins a large share, reported as 70%, of websites.

sources.quote: vulnerability in language used by 70% of sites

claims.statement: Governments and companies took websites offline as a precaution while the flaws were addressed.

sources.quote: Precautionary takedowns come as experts say bad actors could exploit vulnerability
Websites taken down across Europe ahead of critical cyber-security update

claims.statement: Attackers reportedly began exploiting the flaws roughly four days before patches were released.

sources.quote: Amazon Web Services logged attempts to leverage the internet-melting PHP2Shell bugs four days ago.
Amazon says PHP2Shell exploitation began 4 days before patches

claims.statement: OpenAI says researchers using its GPT-5.6 Sol model uncovered the flaws, rated 9.2 in severity, and demonstrated working exploits.

sources.quote: researchers using GPT-5.6 Sol uncovered two critical PHP vulnerabilities with severity scores of 9.2 and demonstrated working exploits

claims.statement: AI involvement in uncovering the flaws triggered a rare, large-scale cyber-security response.

sources.quote: AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.

claims.statement: Cloudflare and others logged millions of attempts to exploit the flaw across the internet.

sources.quote: Cloudflare reports millions of exploit attempts
Websites across world hit by millions of attempts to exploit PHP code flaw

claims.statement: The exploit continued to bypass some protections meant to stop remote code execution even after patches shipped.

sources.quote: PHP2Shell exploit bypasses protections designed to stop remote code execution

claims.statement: Details about the flaws reportedly leaked ahead of the PHP Foundation's planned disclosure.

sources.quote: information about the flaws has reportedly leaked ahead of their scheduled disclosure

claims.statement: Government websites in the EU and Canada were specifically reported taken offline over the flaw.

sources.quote: Government websites in the EU and Canada taken offline over PHP vulnerability

discrepancies.explanation: Tom's Hardware attributes the discovery specifically to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model, while the BBC's explainer credits 'AI' generally without naming a company.

quotes.quote: OpenAI says researchers using GPT-5.6 Sol uncovered two critical PHP vulnerabilities
AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.
